verses.en: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth of his dominion, and all the people, fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities thereof, saying,
verses.sm: Setekaia. O le amio pepelo a Iuta O le afioga na oo mai ia Ieremia mai le ALII, a o tau ma lerusalema ma ona aai uma o Nepukanesa le tupu o Papelonia, ma lana itu taua uma, ma malo uma o le lalolagi na ia pule i ai, ma nuu uma, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah, and tell him, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire:
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, le Atua o Isaraelu, Ina alu ia ma fai atu ia Setekaia le tupu o Iuta, ia faapea atu ia te ia, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, Faauta, ou te tuuina atu lenei aai i le lima o le tupu o Papelonia, e susunuina ai foi e ia i le afi;

verses.en: And thou shalt not escape out of his hand, but shalt surely be taken, and delivered into his hand; and thine eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he shall speak with thee mouth to mouth, and thou shalt go to Babylon.
verses.sm: O oe foi e te le sao i lona lima, a e puea lava oe. ma tuuina i lona lima; e fesilafa‘i oulua ma le tupu o Papelonia, lua te tautala faafesaga'¡ ma ia, e te maliu atu foi i Papelonia.

verses.en: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O Zedekiah king of Judah; Thus saith the LORD of thee, Thou shalt not die by the sword:
verses.sm: A ia e faafofoga mai i le afioga a le ALII, Setekaia e, le tupu o Iuta; o loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII ia te oe, E te le maliu i le pelu;

verses.en: But thou shalt die in peace: and with the burnings of thy fathers, the former kings which were before thee, so shall they burn odours for thee; and they will lament thee, saying, Ah lord! for I have pronounced the word, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: e te rnaliu ma le filemu; e pei ona muina o afi mo ou tama, o tupu anamua sa muamua ia te oe, e faapea foi ona latou muina o le au mo oe; latou te taufaitagitu'i foi ona o oe, e faapea, Aue! le alii e; aua ua ou fai atu le upu, ua fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: Then Jeremiah the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o leremia le perofeta ia Setekaia le tupu o Iuta ia upu uma i Ierusalema,

verses.en: When the king of Babylon's army fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish, and against Azekah: for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Judah.
verses.sm: ina o tau le itu taua a le tupu o Papelonia ma lerusalema, ma ani uma sa totoe i Iuta, o Lakisa ma Aseka; aua o aai nofo ‘olo ia sa totoe i aai o Tuta.

verses.en: This is the word that came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, after that the king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people which were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty unto them;
verses.sm: O le afioga na oo mai ia Ieremia mai le ALII, ina ua mavae ona osia o le feagaiga e Setekaia le tupu ma le nuu uma sa i Ierusalema, e tala‘i atu ia te i latou le saolotoga;

verses.en: That every man should let his manservant, and every man his maidservant, being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess, go free; that none should serve himself of them, to wit, of a Jew his brother.
verses.sm: ia latou taitasi ma tuusaolotoina lana auauna tane, ma lana auauna fafine, o le tane Eperu, ma le fafine Eperu; ina ia le faapologaina e so latou se tagata Eperu, lona uso.

verses.en: Now when all the princes, and all the people, which had entered into the covenant, heard that every one should let his manservant, and every one his maidservant, go free, that none should serve themselves of them any more, then they obeyed, and let them go.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo alii uma, ma le nuu uma na faia le feagaiga, ia latou taitasi ma tuusaolotoina lana auauna tane, ma lana auauna fafine, ina ia latou le toe faapologaina i latou; ona latou usiusitai ai lea, ma tuuina atu i latou ia o.

verses.en: But afterward they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids, whom they had let go free, to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.
verses.sm: Ae mulimuli ane ua latou toe faafoisia mai auauna tane ma auauna fafine na latou tuusaolotoina; ma latou faapologaina i latou e fai ma auauna ‘tane ma auauna fafine.

verses.en: Therefore the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.sm: Ona oo mai ai lea o le afioga a le ALII ia leremia mai le ALII, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondmen, saying,
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, le Atua o Isaraelu, O aʻu lava, na aʻu osia le feagaiga ma o outou tama i le aso na ou aumai ai i latou mai le nuu o Aikupito, o le mea sa nofo pologa ai, ua faapea,

verses.en: At the end of seven years let ye go every man his brother an Hebrew, which hath been sold unto thee; and when he hath served thee six years, thou shalt let him go free from thee: but your fathers hearkened not unto me, neither inclined their ear.
verses.sm: A atoa tausaga e fitu, ia outou taitasi ma tuuina atu e alu lona uso o le Ereru, o le na faatauina ia te oe; e auauna o ia ia te oe i tausaga e ono, ona e tuusaolotoina ai lea o ia; a e lei faalogo mai o outou tama ia te au, e lei uai mai foi o latou taliga.

verses.en: And ye were now turned, and had done right in my sight, in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:
verses.sm: O outou foi, na outou liliu mai i ona po nei, ma outou faia le mea tonu i o'u luma, i lo outou tala‘i atu le saolotoga o le tasi i le tasi; na outou osia foi le feagaiga i oʻu luma i le fale ua taʻua ai loʻu igoa.

verses.en: But ye turned and polluted my name, and caused every man his servant, and every man his handmaid, whom ye had set at liberty at their pleasure, to return, and brought them into subjection, to be unto you for servants and for handmaids.
verses.sm: A ua outou liliu ese, ma faaleagaina loʻu igoa, ma taitasi ma faafoisia mai lana auauna tane, ma lana auauna fafine, na tuusaolotoina i la latou faitalia, ua outou faapologaina i latou e fai ma auauna tane ma auauna fafine ia-te outou.

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Ye have not hearkened unto me, in proclaiming liberty, every one to his brother, and every man to his neighbour: behold, I proclaim a liberty for you, saith the LORD, to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.sm: O le mea lea o loo faapea ona fetalai mai ai o le ALII, Ua outou le faalogo mai ia te au e tala atu le saolotoga, o le tagata i lona uso, ma le tagata i lē la te tuaoi; faauta, ua fetalai mai le ALII, Ou te talaʻi atu ia te outou le saolotoga, i le pelu, ma le faamai, ma le oge; ou te tuuina atu foi outou ia faaatuatuvaleina i malo uma o le lalolagi.

verses.en: And I will give the men that have transgressed my covenant, which have not performed the words of the covenant which they had made before me, when they cut the calf in twain, and passed between the parts thereof,
verses.sm: Ou te tuuina atu foi ia tagata ua solia lau feagaiga, o e ua le faataunuuina upu o le feagaiga na latou osia i oʻu luma, o le tamai povi na latou isiluaina, ma latou ui ane i le va o mea na isiluaina,

verses.en: The princes of Judah, and the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land, which passed between the parts of the calf;
verses.sm: o alii o Iuta, ma alii o Ierusalema, o eunuka, ma faitaulaga, ma tagata uma o le nuu, na ui ane i le va o le tamai povi na isiluaina;

verses.en: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life: and their dead bodies shall be for meat unto the fowls of the heaven, and to the beasts of the earth.
verses.sm: Ou te tuuina atu lava i latou i lima o e ita ia te i latou, ma lima o e saili efasioti ia te i latou; o latou tino foi ua oti e fai ma mea e “ai i manu felelei, ma manu e tataa.

verses.en: And Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babylon's army, which are gone up from you.
verses.sm: Ou te tuuina atu foi o Setekaia le tupu o Iuta, ma alii ua ia te ia, i lima o e ita ia te i latou, ma lima o e saili e fasioti ia te i latou, ma lima o le itu taua a le tupu o Papelonia, o e ua o ae nai ia te outou.

verses.en: Behold, I will command, saith the LORD, and cause them to return to this city; and they shall fight against it, and take it, and burn it with fire: and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without an inhabitant.
verses.sm: Faauta, ou te fai atu, ua fetalai mai le ALII, ma ou faafoisia mai i latou i lenei aai; latou te sii i ai le taua, latou te aea foi, ma susunuina i le afi; ou te tuuina atu foi o aai o Iuta, ia faatafunaina, ia leai sē nofo ai.
